serverUrl.title: TopoTrace server URL
serverUrl.description: Base origin of the TopoTrace server, e.g. https://topotrace.example.com or http://192.168.1.20:8080. No trailing slash required -- background.js normalizes it.

hostName.title: Host name
hostName.description: Exactly the host name this Chromebook was enrolled under in TopoTrace's Agents tab (GET/POST /api/enrollments).

token.title: Enrollment token
token.description: The one-time enrollment token minted for this host in TopoTrace's Agents tab. Scoped to this host only -- see model.Enrollment's doc comment on the server.

reportIntervalMinutes.title: Report interval (minutes)
reportIntervalMinutes.description: How often to report, in minutes. Optional -- defaults to 30 if unset, clamped to 30-60 either way (chrome.alarms' own practical floor plus this task's 30-60 minute cadence).
